title: audit logs api tenant isolation and filtering
description: Verify that the Audit Logs API correctly retrieves audit logs filtered by business_id (tenant) and supports filtering by action, type, and date range, ensuring tenant data isolation.

title: team management api create member with role hierarchy enforcement
description: Test the creation of a team member via the Team Management API ensuring that role hierarchy enforcement prevents unauthorized role assignments such as Managers assigning Owner roles.

title: team management api update member role with hierarchy validation
description: Validate that updating a team member's role through the Team Management API enforces strict role hierarchy rules, preventing unauthorized role escalations.

title: rtbf deletion api pii masking and tenant role removal
description: Ensure the RTBF Deletion API permanently masks all personally identifiable information (PII) of the specified user and removes tenant roles to comply with privacy regulations.
